decisions.reason: The breakpoint approval concerns general website responsive behavior; the same message separately limits this Requirement to styling guidance for the specialized dashboard shell.
Breakpoint guidance does not change the independently established dark theme or non-switchable theme behavior.
The breakpoint approval does not change whether the footer is shared across website pages or otherwise modify the footer Requirement.
The approved general breakpoint guidance necessarily supplies the implementation basis for the landing page's already-required responsive behavior.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
With the website now my highest priority, Marissa, here is where each item stands despite how busy I have been:

1\. Although I may send a few small copy revisions shortly, the top half of the landing page looks great, so please begin with that.
2\. Agreed: use the common headers and footers and retain the dark theme.
3\. The responsive breakpoint guidance is okay.
4\. In the attached Prototype UI, the dashboard is working with an app for agent chat. Because the dashboard has its own specialized build process, my scope at this stage is only styling guidance for the shell container. I am happy to handle that as another milestone.

The attached documents describe the website build approach I have settled on. Any feedback would be welcome and appreciated.

Best,
Derek

value_updates.breakpoint_basis: Use the previously shared breakpoint guidelines.

decisions.reason: Responsive breakpoint guidance does not change the landing page's copy plan, section order, setup sequence, or sequence visual.
